speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis. The clinical presentation of a generalized erythematous maculopapular rash with pustules, an erythematous base, and sparing of the palms and soles in a 4-day-old newborn, despite a treated maternal history, is consistent with early congenital syphilis. The negative syphilis serology in a 4-year-old mother does not rule out reinfection or treatment failure during this pregnancy.
